user.title: Connect to Tesira
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Biamp Tesira device. Blocks will be discovered after connecting.

source_selectors.title: Select source selectors
source_selectors.description: Select the source selector blocks to add as media player entities.

select_routers.title: Select routers
select_routers.description: Select the router blocks to configure. Each selected router will be walked through one output at a time.

router.title: {router_name} — output {output_number} of {num_outputs}
router.description: Select the level block to assign to output {output_number} of this router, or choose 'None' to skip this output.

data.level_block: Level block to add for output {output_number}

data_description.level_block: The level block that will control volume for output {output_number} of {router_name}.

levels.title: Select level blocks
levels.description: Select any additional level blocks to add as number entities. Blocks already assigned to routers are not shown.

mutes.title: Select mute blocks
mutes.description: Select the mute blocks to add as switch entities. Each block creates one switch per channel.

logic_states.title: Select logic state blocks
logic_states.description: Select the logic state blocks to add as switch entities.

logic_meters.title: Select logic meter blocks
logic_meters.description: Select the logic meter blocks to add as binary sensor entities.
